title: Content / AEO Engine
summary: Answer-first content produced against the citation-gap list and published through approval gates.

trigger.description: A ranked gap brief from the Citation Deck is approved for production.

agents.name: researcher
agents.role: Assembles sources, entities, numbers and the question set the piece must answer; drafts the Direct Answer block first.

agents.name: drafter-answer
agents.role: Writes an answer-first draft: the Direct Answer up top, question-shaped headings, extractable blocks.

agents.name: drafter-example
agents.role: Writes an example-led draft: concrete client scenarios and specific numbers carry the argument.

agents.name: drafter-concise
agents.role: Writes the tightest possible draft: the shortest path from question to a citable answer.

agents.name: editor
agents.role: Judges the three competing drafts against the citability checklist and picks or synthesizes the most citable, on-brand version.

agents.name: optimizer
agents.role: Applies AEO structure: question-shaped headings, extractable blocks, FAQ, schema markup; runs the citability checklist.

agents.name: publisher
agents.role: Stages the piece in the CMS with schema and internal links; publishes only through the gate.

rollback: Stop pulling from the gap-brief queue; staged drafts remain in the CMS as drafts. Published pieces are never auto-retracted — archive-don't-delete.
